# Sort message headers before building paginated extension results

messages.list obtains a folder array and calls sortMessages before MessageListTracker.startList. The sorter snapshots headers and orders them before the list converts each result into an extension MessageHeader. startList returns the first page while later additions continue; sorting itself is completed before that paging phase. Both API manifest versions expose 11 sort types and default to descending when a type is supplied. The new ten-message test directly checks default values and expected subject sequences, with six NNTP cases skipped. It does not test a continuation page, benchmark speed, or prove complex encoded address fields are unchanged by sorting.

Scope: WebExtension messages API.
